name: Christopher M. Huck
tagline: Top rated General Litigation attorney in Seattle, Washington
side_practice_areas: General Litigation, Business Litigation, Intellectual Property Litigation

about: Christopher M. Huck is an attorney who represents clients in the Seattle, Washington area. Christopher Huck is recognized by peers and was selected to Super Lawyers for 2014 - 2026. This selection is based off of an evaluation of 12 indicators including peer recognition and professional achievement in legal practice.

Christopher Huck chose to pursue a career in law after completing undergraduate studies. He attended University of Notre Dame Law School and graduated in 2000. Christopher Huck passed the bar exam and was admitted to legal practice in 2001.
He represents clients with General Litigation issues in Washington. He also represents clients with Business Litigation, Intellectual Property Litigation and Securities Litigation issues.

Being selected to Super Lawyers is limited to a small number of attorneys in each state. As one of the few attorneys to garner the distinction of Super Lawyers, Christopher Huck has earned the respect of peers as one of the top-rated attorneys in the nation.
